answered.sql: SELECT A.name AS Medicine, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN E.sideEffectID IN (SELECT sideEffectID FROM Common_Side_Effects) THEN C.description ELSE NULL END, ', ') AS Common_Side_Effects, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN E.sideEffectID IN (SELECT seriousSideEffectID FROM Serious_Side_Effects) THEN C.description ELSE NULL END, ', ') AS Serious_Side_Effects FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID JOIN Common_Side_Effects C ON A.commonSideEffects LIKE '%' || CAST(C.sideEffectID AS TEXT) || '%' JOIN Serious_Side_Effects S ON A.seriousSideEffects LIKE '%' || CAST(S.seriousSideEffectID AS TEXT) || '%' WHERE Pt.firstName = 'Jane' AND Pt.lastName = 'Smith' GROUP BY A.name

candidates.meaning: Show the name of the medicine and its common side effects for Mr. Smith.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, C.description FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Common_Side_Effects C ON A.commonSideEffects = C.sideEffectID JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID WHERE Pt.firstName || ' ' || Pt.lastName = 'Jane Smith'

candidates.meaning: Show the medicine and its common and serious side effects for Mr. Smith.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.name, C.description AS common_side_effects, D.description AS serious_side_effects FROM Antibiotic A JOIN Prescription P ON A.antibioticID = P.antibioticID JOIN Patient Pt ON P.patientID = Pt.patientID JOIN Common_Side_Effects C ON A.commonSideEffects = C.sideEffectID JOIN Serious_Side_Effects D ON A.seriousSideEffects = D.seriousSideEffectID WHERE Pt.firstName = 'Jane' AND Pt.lastName = 'Smith'
